scope: Native desktop network child and generic masked input; regular-user guest operations through an owned simulated WPA2/hidden AP. Physical Wi-Fi and complete control-center delivery remain unfinished.
source_commit_scope: Runtime sources and baselines compiled and tested at this commit; later commits add evidence/docs only.
architecture: Composition root selects NetworkManager and injects Arc<dyn NetworkPort>; child update/view have no transport or root imports.
One signal subscription supplies observed network state; the previous nmcli system-status poll and network terminal wizard are removed.
MaskedInput stores count/placeholder and edit callback; generic input buffers/hit values hold no password. InputEdit Debug redacts deltas.
Private generation-bound form owns a zeroizing Secret; submission consumes non-Clone/non-Debug credentials into one owned effect. Join retries require new credentials.
Current IDs and original SSID octets are validated; acceptance does not mutate observed connection/scan state. Close releases input, then unmounts after token-defined motion.
Shared row measurement uses allocated fill widths, and intrinsic text fitting accounts for padding subtraction roundoff. Regression tests cover clipping.

native_environment.network: real NetworkManager; owned mac80211_hwsim radios, hostapd and DHCP

idle.scope: main process CPU and resident mappings; child processes excluded; mapped driver/software-GPU memory may contribute to RSS

performance.notes: A single warm workload on a capped software-rendered guest. Not a peak-memory bound, hardware benchmark or comparative memory reduction. GPU allocations were not separately measured.

pending: Network secret-agent prompts; enterprise/WEP/VPN provisioning; physical Wi-Fi, SAE/OWE, captive portals and suspend/hotplug reliability.
Native Bluetooth, brightness, battery/power profiles and tray lifecycle; physical audio/card profiles.
RSS below 200 MiB, active overlay/decode peaks, GPU allocations, hardware pacing and longer idle/fault checks.
Per-output/fractional scale and hotplug; richer dock/widget/notification/settings behavior and packaging/migrations.
Text shaping/fallback, IME, grapheme/caret/selection/clipboard editing, accessibility, touch and richer scrolling/focus lifecycle.

Existing greeter ClearInput only clears secret storage, not the username; failed retries can append identity text. Test login used bounded Backspace and short Enter holds. This client bug is not fixed in this milestone.
Secure-client build alignment/revalidation and the remaining acceptance ledger in docs/implementation-status.json.
